summary: A Ledger user discovered roughly 4000 dollars in crypto missing long after purchase and could not confirm how wallet credentials were exposed though possible seed phrase visibility or insecure backup handling was discussed. No confirmed attacker method was identified but unauthorized asset transfer implies wallet recovery data or signing authority was compromised
user_mistake: seed storage or handling may have exposed recovery data
prevention: Rotate funds after any seed uncertainty / Store recovery phrase with tamper evident access controls
